Unmodified source, built locally by scripts/build-media-adapter.mjs; only get/send used. No remote binary download at runtime, no network or settings changes. macOS MediaRemote is a private API. The helper is loaded by the system Perl host as described by upstream; neither SIP nor entitlements of installed apps are modified.
